question: Can a new 2026 player cohort constrain Midnight crushing denominator and does specialization increase dust quantity or rank?

newOriginalCohort.author: Diffracted-3169329
newOriginalCohort.caution: 43 prospect operations self-reported, not log-verified. 34 gems and 24 dust are aggregate units; 34/3 is not an actual crushing cast count. 15 ore difference does not prove refunds without an inventory ledger. 0 diamonds is not a zero true probability. Do not assign ore/rank IDs.

newIndependentQualitativeReports.author: Aragion-3117702
newIndependentQualitativeReports.claim: Crushing skill increases dust rank R1 to R2, not dust count; mentions 1-3 per crush

newIndependentQualitativeReports.author: Greentea-3273980

modelProposal.suggestion: Separate dust-rank skill/concentration model from dust-quantity model. Do not apply generic crushing-skill quantity multiplier until controlled matched cohorts verify it.
notPermitted: Do not infer crushing casts as 34/3
Do not assign 'silver' exact ore ID or quality rank
Do not infer exactly 15 refunded ore

measurementRequest.question: Does Crushing Connoisseur affect dust units per cast or only dust rank for a fixed gem item ID/rank?
measurementRequest.protocol: Matched low/high specialization at identical input gem ID/rank, spell 1231132 and patch. Capture 200+ completed casts per arm when feasible, including zeros, dust output item IDs/ranks, 3-gem and stone consumption/refunds, skill/gear/concentration and aborts. Verify selector separately.
